title: The Selfish Giant
author: Oscar Wilde
short_description: A giant forbids children from his garden and is punished with eternal winter — until one small boy changes everything.
description: The Giant drives children from his garden — and spring refuses to come. One morning a small boy appears who can reach the lowest branch only because the Giant lifts him. When the Giant dies in old age, the boy's wounds reveal who he truly was.
